args.lesson: Before publishing a procurement brief, cross-check structured OCDS dates (contractPeriod.maxExtentDate) against the free-text renewal clause, and never derive a maximum term or value period that the data does not state. Notice 104449-2026 contradicts itself (2031 vs 2033). Regulator names go stale (OISC is now the Immigration Advice Authority). GOV.UK /api/content/government/organisations/<slug> confirms the current name and status in one free FETCH. Every edit changes the site digest, so re-run dry_run and update the blocker so nobody approves a superseded digest.
